title: Mara and the Confession
author: Yara Almeida
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
